description: The line plot illustrates the performance of FreqKV across different values of the parameter γ (gamma), measured by PPL (Perplexity), as a function of context window size. The x-axis represents the context window size, ranging from 2K to 64K, with logarithmic spacing indicated by the tick marks at 2K, 4K, 8K, 16K, 32K, and 64K. The y-axis shows the PPL values, which range from approximately 7.7 to 8.2, with grid lines at intervals of 0.1. Three distinct lines are plotted, each corresponding to a different value of γ: γ=0.25 (blue), γ=0.5 (orange), and γ=0.75 (green). All three lines exhibit a sharp decrease in PPL from the 2K context window to the 4K context window, with the blue line starting at a PPL of approximately 8.2 and the green line at 8.21. After the 4K point, the PPL values for all three lines stabilize and remain relatively flat. The blue line (γ=0.25) maintains a PPL of about 7.8 from 4K onwards, the orange line (γ=0.5) stabilizes around 7.75, and the green line (γ=0.75) settles at approximately 7.73. The plot shows that while γ=0.75 achieves the lowest PPL values across most of the context window sizes, the performance differences between the three values of γ become minimal beyond the 4K context window.
